verses.1: A Psalm of David, in commemoration of the Sabbath.
verses.2: O Lord, do not rebuke me in your fury, nor chastise me in your wrath.
verses.3: For your arrows have been driven into me, and your hand has been confirmed over me.
verses.4: There is no health in my flesh before the face of your wrath. There is no peace for my bones before the face of my sins.
verses.5: For my iniquities have walked over my head, and they have been like a heavy burden weighing upon me.
verses.6: My sores have putrefied and been corrupted before the face of my foolishness.
verses.7: I have become miserable, and I have been bent down, even to the end. I have walked with contrition all day long.
verses.8: For my loins have been filled with illusions, and there is no health in my flesh.
verses.9: I have been afflicted and greatly humbled. I bellowed from the groaning of my heart.
verses.10: O Lord, all my desire is before you, and my groaning before you has not been hidden.
verses.11: My heart has been disturbed. My strength has abandoned me, and the light of my eyes has abandoned me, and it is not with me.
verses.12: My friends and my neighbors have drawn near and stood against me. And those who were next to me stood far apart. And those who sought my soul used violence.
verses.13: And those who sought evil accusations against me were speaking emptiness. And they practiced deceitfulness all day long.
verses.14: But, like someone deaf, I did not hear. And I was like someone mute, not opening his mouth.
verses.15: And I became like a man who does not hear, and who has no reproofs in his mouth.
verses.16: For in you, Lord, I have hoped. You will listen to me, O Lord my God.
verses.17: For I said, “Lest at any time, my enemies might rejoice over me,” and, “While my feet are being shaken, they have spoken great things against me.”
verses.18: For I have been prepared for scourges, and my sorrow is ever before me.
verses.19: For I will announce my iniquity, and I will think about my sin.
verses.20: But my enemies live, and they have been stronger than me. And those who have wrongfully hated me have been multiplied.
verses.21: Those who render evil for good have dragged me down, because I followed goodness.
verses.22: Do not forsake me, O Lord my God. Do not depart from me.
verses.23: Be attentive to my help, O Lord, the God of my salvation. [ Psalm 38 ] (39)
